description: The SGD multiplier on the BN biases was inherited from the SGD era and never re-tested under Muon. Base: E116 code. Change only the LR multiplier of the BN-bias SGD group from 64x to 32x, through its 0-d LR tensor or a host constant so nothing recompiles. The whitening-stem bias (E093 showed it is fragile), the head bias, the warmup and the Muon groups are unchanged. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline. Add one scored run.
